name: Game Market (Osaka)
blurb: The Kansai-region edition of Japan's largest tabletop-game market, where designers and small publishers sell their own games directly to attendees.
notes: No Kansai/Osaka-region edition has a confirmed date or venue for the research window (2026-10-05 to 2027-12-31). The official site's own overview page states Game Market runs 3 times a year with the Kansai-region leg in winter, but as of this check gamemarket.jp only had a published date for the Tokyo 2026 Autumn show (see game-market-tokyo.json); there is no dedicated Osaka page live right now, and a web search turned up no confirmed Osaka date more recent than a past (2024) edition. Cover reuses the main Game Market logo since there is no Osaka-specific page or key art to cite yet; editions is empty per the window rule rather than guessing a date.
